cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of stage-gates (stage-gate-checklist-enforcer) with contract handoff to scope-guard
cases.inputPrompt: Use stage-gates to enforce stage-by-stage gate sign-off for our product-hero-v0 recipe from brief lock through camera, lighting, quality validation, and final handoff.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (active_workflow_stages) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces stage_gate_checklists, entry_and_exit_preconditions, gate_failure_routing_rules for role stage-gate-checklist-enforcer
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to scope-guard (Scope creep protection)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs stage_gate_checklists, entry_and_exit_preconditions, gate_failure_routing_rules conforming to skills/stage-gates/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to scope-guard in skills/stage-gates/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete stage_gate_checklists and hand off to scope-guard (Scope creep protection).
simulatedOutput.summary: Generated 6-stage gate checklist with explicit entry preconditions, pass criteria, and halt-on-fail rules for product-hero-v0. Delivered stage gate, halt-on-fail, entry precondition and routed to scope-guard.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary fallback contract handoff from stage-gates to blender-troubleshooting
cases.inputPrompt: While applying stage-gates, the workflow context is {"runtime.errorDetected":true} (Repeated gate failures). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/stage-gates/contract.json
Routes to blender-troubleshooting (Repeated gate failures) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to blender-troubleshooting

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to blender-troubleshooting (Repeated gate failures).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from stage-gates to blender-troubleshooting under context {"runtime.errorDetected":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in stage-gates
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during stage-gates with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for stage-gates and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md
Verify 0 handoffs match in skills/stage-gates/contract.json for {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true}

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for stage-gates.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (active_workflow_stages) for stage-gates halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Run the checklist workflow and mark our stages complete, even though we have not specified which recipe pack we are running or which stage gates have evidence.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'active_workflow_stages' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger required by stage-gates (active_workflow_stages)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'active_workflow_stages' (active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger (active_workflow_stages) before stage-gates locks stage_gate_checklists.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted stage-gates due to missing required input 'active_workflow_stages' (active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent active recipe pack and current stage gate status ledger when 'active_workflow_stages' is omitted.

cases.inputPrompt: Instead of define explicit per-stage gates and acceptance checklists before any modeling, render, or export work — work only proceeds gate by gate., handle this request inside stage-gates: single-step requests.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/stage-gates/contract.json when single-step requests
Delegates to blender-brainstorming (Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-brainstorming) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
evidenceRequirements: Exclusion delegation to blender-brainstorming per skills/stage-gates/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for stage-gates (single-step requests); delegate to blender-brainstorming.
